assignmentTitle: Design of Helical Gears for High-Speed Rotary Equipment
courseOutcome: CO1: Apply principle of Spur & Helical gear design for industrial application.

criteria.title: Kinematic Specification & Pinion Torque
criteria.description: Accurate determination of transmission ratio i = 3.0 and rated pinion torque T1 = 99,471.84 N·mm from power (15 kW) and speed (1440 rpm).

criteria.title: Virtual Teeth & Lewis Form Factor
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of virtual/formative teeth (z1' = 21.69, z2' = 65.08) and Lewis form factors (Yv1 = 0.3517, Yv2 = 0.4399) based on helix angle psi = 20 deg.

criteria.title: Weaker Element Comparative Evaluation
criteria.description: Evaluation of permissible bending stresses (sigma_b1 = 266.67 MPa, sigma_b2 = 200.00 MPa) and strength products (Pinion: 93.79 MPa vs Gear: 87.98 MPa) to identify Gear (55C8 plain carbon steel) as the weaker element.

criteria.title: Gear Pitch Geometry & Centre Distance
criteria.description: Accurate computation of pitch circle diameters (d1 = 76.62 mm, d2 = 229.86 mm) and centre distance (a = 153.24 mm) with normal module mn = 4 mm.

criteria.title: Pitch-Line Velocity & Barth Dynamic Factor
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of pitch line velocity (v = 5.78 m/s) and Barth dynamic velocity factor (Cv = 0.700 / 0.6997).

criteria.title: Tangential & Effective Dynamic Load
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of transverse tangential force (Pt = 2596.47 N) and effective dynamic tooth load (Peff = 6030.20 N) using service (Ka = 1.25) and mounting (Km = 1.30) factors.

criteria.title: Lewis Beam Strength & Bending FOS
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of Lewis beam strength for weaker gear (Sb = 14,076.78 N) and bending safety factor (FOSb = 2.33 >= 1.50: SAFE).

criteria.title: Buckingham Wear Strength & Wear FOS
criteria.description: Accurate determination of ratio factor (Q = 1.50), load-stress factor (K = 1.00 N/mm² for 250 BHN), Buckingham wear strength (Sw = 5206.27 N), and wear safety factor (FOSw = 0.86 < 1.50: UNSAFE).

criteria.title: Engineering Diagnosis & Defect Identification
criteria.description: Correct engineering diagnosis identifying surface wear/pitting as the governing failure mode requiring parametric redesign.

criteria.title: Parametric Redesign Calculations
criteria.description: Accurate recalculation for Option A (b=55mm: Sw=7158.61 N, FOSw=1.19 [Insufficient]), Option B1 (350 BHN: K=1.96 N/mm², Sw=10,204.28 N, FOSw=1.69 [Satisfies Target]), and Option C (mn=5mm, b=50mm: d1=95.78mm, Peff=4995.16 N, Sw=8134.79 N, FOSw=1.63 [Satisfies Target]).

criteria.title: Engineering Recommendation & Trade-Off Defense
criteria.description: Faculty evaluation of open-ended student defense comparing surface hardening (350 BHN) vs. module enlargement (mn = 5 mm), casing envelope impact, manufacturing feasibility of 55C8 plain carbon steel, and operational reliability.

criteria.title: Engineering Design Synthesis & Reflection
criteria.description: Faculty evaluation of student reflection connecting dynamic velocity factors, surface pitting vs beam bending trade-offs, and documentation of design assumptions.
